completenessChecks: 17 narrative paragraphs and 2 section headings translated in original order; the source record counts 17 body blocks plus 2 headings.
3 caption lines translated with credits (Daniel Ahs Karlsson, PR, AP).
Secondary quotations keep their original attributions (the Observer; Tor Brandacher).

voiceChecks: The one-sentence catalogue of Frida's life kept as a single long semicolon list with the '(take a breath, this is a long one)' aside intact.
The body is almost entirely serious historical narration; no humor was added and the restrained register was kept throughout the Lebensborn passages.
Small dry touches kept at the same weight ('65 years of existence on the planet', 'not to say cynically "created"', 'To Frida's (relative) good fortune').
Captions kept in the telegraphic two-part style.

The source's scrambled album and song punctuation ('"נשימות עמוקות"), "Djupa andetag"' and '"השמש תזרח שוב", Shine Again The Sun Will"') rendered in normal English order: 'Djupa andetag' ('Deep Breaths') and 'The Sun Will Shine Again'.
